$comment: Child starts whose environment is not a childEnvironment(...) call at the call site (child-env-census.test.ts). Each row lists the file's such starts, each as its callee and the env it passes exactly as the scanner reads it (or the start's name and where it is passed as a value), and why each is safe; changing what a start passes fails until its row changes. 'forwarded': the env was built by childEnvironment upstream and passed through. 'owned': a fixed, caller-built env that inherits nothing broadly. A row may not hold a start that inherits process.env. A start passing a plain name also pins every value that name is given in the file; a row's handsProcessEnvTo pins each call that is handed process.env whole.
